item.title: 4.9 Quake Rattles Indio, Coachella & Palm Desert Area
item.description: An earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 4.9, followed quickly by a 3.4 aftershock, rattled the Coachella Valley and nearby areas just before 6 p.m. Monday, but there were no immediate reports of damage.
